adaptation: One shared source implements direct/precise-cross and split partial/merge. B580 retains SIMD16 DPAS with 2D block IO. A770 uses SIMD8 DPAS with raw-word scalar loads and probability shuffles, selected at compile time when 2D block IO is absent. Both use the same raw-BF16 and FP32 partial-buffer ABI. A770 split partial uses repeat-eight DPAS in one active subgroup to reuse K/V across the existing eight-query tile; direct and merge retain two four-row subgroups. The 16-thread XML workgroup and output ABI are unchanged.
